rationale: 3-hydroxy-4-oxo-pyranone (flavonol) core. The ring carbonyl is a vinylogous ester within an aromatic-stabilized pyranone rather than a ketone enone, so the system is not a thiol Michael acceptor. Perception of the ring as aliphatic varies between RDKit versions, so the exclusion is declared explicitly to keep the inventory reproducible. This table is the definition of the rule: annotate_motifs.py reads the SMARTS and the motif list from here rather than holding its own copy.
